items.prompt: In the application essay, the applicant must give the reasons for wishing to study at the chosen field of their intended department in SPSF.
items.ru: Для Journalism, Education, Sociology, Economics и Management: эссе примерно на 500 слов о том, почему вы хотите учиться именно на этом отделении SPSF.
items.evidence: In the application essay, the applicant must give the reasons for wishing to study at the chosen field of their intended department in SPSF. It should be approximately 500 words in length and typed in English on the provided form.

items.prompt: Please outline your vision for studying in the SPSF Global Studies Program in approximately 500 words (excluding book references) in English. Describe the topic or issue you wish to explore, explain why it interests you, and what you hope to learn through this program, mentioning up to three books and/or other sources of information you have consulted on the topic.
items.ru: Для Global Studies: эссе примерно на 500 слов о теме, которую хотите изучать, со списком до трёх книг или источников.

items.ru: Два письма на английском или японском от учителей и/или работников школы. Если подаёте на несколько отделений, письма всё равно две — на всю SPSF.
items.evidence: Letters of recommendation in English or in Japanese from two teachers and/or officials of the school(s) attended by the applicant must be submitted.

items.ru: Английский подтверждают TOEFL iBT или IELTS (Academic), тест сдан не больше двух лет назад, балл есть к последнему дню приёма заявок.
